text.p: Swiss pharmaceuticals group Ares-Serono SA confirmed that it expected 1997 to be a promising year following the 90 percent rise in first quarter group net profit.

"With the 90 percent net profit increase for the first quarter, 1997 should be another promising year for Ares-Serono," a company statement quoted chief executive officer Ernesto Bertarelli as saying to the annual shareholders' meeting.
On April 29 Ares-Serono reported a 89.9 percent rise in 1997 first quarter group net profit to $16.4 million and forecast another successful year.
The shareholders approved the 1996 accounts and the proposal to raise the dividend to 2.00 francs per registered share from 1.20 francs and to 5.00 francs per bearer share from 3.0 francs.
They also approved management's proposal to create conditional and authorised capital.
